chosen.label: MilitaryAttackEvent
chosen.definition: An event involving a military attack on infrastructure or personnel
chosen.justification: Examples describe attacks on oil refineries and patrol boats, which don't match schema.org's SportsEvent or other candidates.

examples: Ukraine attacks Black Sea patrol boats and shadow fleet
Russia attacks Ukraine's cities and energy facilities

candidates.label: UserPlusOnes
candidates.comment: An outdated type representing a user's interaction of giving a "+1" endorsement, typically on Google+ or similar platforms. Also called user endorsement, +1, social recommendation. Examples: a user giving a +1 to a web page, endorsing a business, recommending content.

candidates.label: UserCheckins
candidates.comment: An outdated type representing a user's interaction of checking into a location or event. Also called user check-in, location check-in, event attendance. Examples: a user checking into a restaurant, checking into a concert, marking attendance at a conference.

candidates.label: SportsEvent
candidates.comment: An event involving athletic competition or display. Also called athletic contest, game, match, sporting competition. Examples: a football game, an Olympic event, a marathon race, a tennis tournament.

candidates.label: UserInteraction
candidates.comment: An outdated general type representing any interaction a user has with a web page or content. Also called user activity, user engagement, web interaction. Examples: a user clicking a link, submitting a form, scrolling a page.

candidates.label: UserTweets
candidates.comment: An outdated type representing a user's interaction of posting a tweet on Twitter. Also called user tweet, microblog post, social media update. Examples: a user posting a message on Twitter, sharing a link via tweet, replying to another tweet.

chosen.label: InfrastructureDamageEvent
chosen.definition: An event where infrastructure is damaged or destroyed
chosen.justification: Kherson city blackout represents infrastructure damage not captured by schema.org's user interaction or theater event types.

candidates.label: UserBlocks
candidates.comment: An outdated type representing a user's interaction of blocking another user or content. Also called user block, content block, account block. Examples: a user blocking another user on a social media platform, blocking a specific website, blocking notifications from an app.

candidates.label: OnDemandEvent
candidates.comment: An OnDemandEvent, as a PublicationEvent, is a publication event where a program is available on-demand. Also called catch-up TV, podcast release, streaming event. Examples: a TV show episode available for streaming after broadcast, a podcast episode release, a movie available for rent online. Distinct from BroadcastEvent, which is a live or scheduled transmission.

candidates.label: TheaterEvent
candidates.comment: An event representing a live performance in a theater. Also called stage play, theatrical show, drama performance. Examples: a Broadway musical, a local community play, a Shakespearean tragedy.

chosen.label: MilitaryInterceptionEvent
chosen.definition: An event where military forces intercept another's equipment or assets
chosen.justification: Russia intercepting Ukrainian drones represents a military interception not matched by any schema.org candidates.
